rationale: The last five 1-minute candles show lower highs (92.54 → 91.95), lower lows (92.31 → 91.87), and net selling pressure with the largest volume bar on the 91.87 close. Price has given back two-thirds of its maximum favorable excursion while stalling exactly at the 9-EMA and failing to sustain the higher-high/higher-low pattern present at entry. Although still above session VWAP and inside a contracting-volatility regime, the immediate directional evidence has shifted from the recovery momentum that justified the long.
